verdict.rationale: Evidence shows dbt Projects on Snowflake can 'orchestrate' transformations with a managed runtime, implying some recurring-job scheduling capability, but the pack contains no direct documentation of Snowflake's native TASK/scheduler object or agent-triggered recurring workflows for AI-native users. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Snowflake Tasks or a scheduler API, evidence of AI agents creating/managing recurring jobs via MCP or CLI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of scheduling reliability.
